name: Mỗi tuổi một ngọn nến
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame, the middle of each remembered year (PAUSE.inBeat into its caption), the climax (PAUSE.climax: every candle burning, the wish, the ring round the cake) and the last frame (the fairy lights). Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. Between stops the film keeps the scene's own pace and ease-in-out. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: mem0-n ... mem5-n are the ages over the remembered years (label: the big numeral, right-aligned in a box for two digits, so a one-digit age stands a little in from the line below), mem0-l ... mem5-l their lines (caption), wish the "make a wish" line (caption, its last line kept where the scene puts it), name her name piped on the cake (text, Pacifico). Captions fade with the scene (alpha is the 5th number of each box). Compromises: a film shared by every card has one fixed cake, so the number of candles (25), which years the camera lingers on (1, 6, 12, 18, 22, 25) and the garland's words (SINH NHẬT VUI VẺ) are the demo's and cannot change per card; a card changes the numbers and words shown, not the film. The word "tuổi" beside each age is in the film. In the scene her name is piped into the cake and lit with it; here the player paints it on top, and its alpha follows the light on the cake (dark until the candles catch, dimmed by the shade beside a memory and the veil at the end), so it comes out of the dark with the cake but is drawn flat over the glaze drips and the falling confetti. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
